column1: 5.5.4.2.8.24 Show/ Hide Windows – Show / Hide Emitters Watch Window. User
shall click on this menu item to show/ hide ‘Emitters Watch Window’ GUI in SCD Main
Window. This shall be a toggling menu item and shall switch between ‘Show Emitters
Watch Window’ & ‘Hide Emitters Watch Window’ options. By default, ‘Emitters Watch
Window’ GUI shall be hidden. Emitters based on Operator selected filters (Freq, PW and
PRF) will be shown in this window. Operator has the facility to modify filters.
5.5.4.2.9 Display Filter Menu. This menu (as shown in Figure 5.63) shall include
controls for selecting and applying display filters w.r.t. ‘Track Status’, ‘Bands & Sectors’,
